# Kafka Streams Specialist Skill

> **Category:** Tech Skills > Others > Apache Kafka

## Overview

Builds stream processing applications with Kafka Streams including topology design, state stores, and windowed aggregations

## Quick Start

1. Copy this skill folder to your workspace under `.github/skills/`
2. Reference in agent files: `skills: [kafka-streams-specialist-skill]`
3. The skill activates automatically when the agent is invoked

## Structure

```text
kafka-streams-specialist-skill/
  SKILL.md    # Skill definition with procedures and standards
  GUIDE.md    # This guide
```

## Companion Agent

This skill is designed to work with the `@kafka-streams-specialist` agent from the Independent Agents catalogue.

## Key Capabilities

- Design stream processing topologies
- Implement windowed aggregations
- Configure state stores for stateful processing
- Build stream-table joins for enrichment

## Technology Standards Applied

- **Kafka Streams**: Stream processing API and patterns
- **State Stores**: Stateful processing and state management
- **Windowing**: Time-based aggregation patterns
